annotation.kind: source selection, tier label, and indexed Algorithm 1.1 execution contract

assumptions: The system dimension is positive and A is nonsingular, witnessed by the inverse action of Ainv.
The indexed computed quantities satisfy Algorithm 1.1's exact residual and update equations, componentwise error models (3.3) and (3.6), and normwise correction-solver condition (2.4).
The unit roundoffs satisfy u_r <= u <= u_s <= u_f, gamma_p^r has a positive denominator, c1_i and c2_i are nonnegative, and c1_i*kappa_inf(A)*u_s < 1 pointwise.

conditions.L: The identical fixed statement and P03 shared files are present; the frozen NumStability library is also present.
conditions.N: The fixed statement and P03 shared files are present; no NumStability artifact is present.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p03_t3_normwise_residual_contraction {n : ℕ} (run : P03NormwiseIRRun n) (i : ℕ) : p03VecInfNorm (p03ExactResidual run (i + 1)) ≤ p03Alpha run i * p03VecInfNorm (p03ExactResidual run i) + p03Beta run i
formal_statement.plain_language: Every indexed execution satisfying Algorithm 1.1's residual, correction-solver, and update contracts obeys the exact alpha_i residual contraction plus beta_i floor in Theorem 4.1.

informal_proof: Use Ainv and (2.4) to bound and isolate the correction defect; derive norm bounds from the componentwise models (3.3) and (3.6); substitute them into the exact one-step identity (4.1); then collect the exact alpha_i and beta_i coefficients.
informal_statement: The exact Algorithm 1.1 normwise residual recurrence in Theorem 4.1.

review_record_not_for_run_prompt.note: The frozen library's one-step residual theorem assumes a backward-error matrix that the paper's normwise solver contract does not provide. Its remaining infinity-norm facts are elementary adapters and do not materially advance Theorem 4.1.

source_locations.role: exact residual identity, correction-defect isolation, and residual recurrence
normwise residual recurrence with alpha_i and beta_i

tier_rationale: The frozen library has no corresponding theorem for the paper's normwise correction-solver contract or its exact alpha_i and beta_i recurrence. Generic finite-matrix and infinity-norm facts are elementary and available equally from Mathlib-level reasoning; both conditions must build the substantive proof from the paper source.
